solution is not using the default value for scale, but set scale to be "width".

Yang

On Tuesday, March 5, 2013 2:56:45 PM UTC-5, Qingyang Li wrote:

A scaling problem of ggplot2's geom_violin -- Scaling is different for two geom_violin layers 

Hi all,

I have some data which I need to plot their distribution.
The data I have are three measures from a subject, and the meausers were taken under three conditions (baseline, cond1, cond2).
What I wanted to do is to plot the distribution of cond 1 and cond2 with baseline as background. I followed Brandon Hurr's suggestion and used 2 layers with alpha. As a quality check, I also plotted baseline on both the layers. What I found is that the baseline in the two layers are not the same.
Since my data files were too large, I am going to demostrate the problem using random numbers. In the figure generated, the red lines are my data, and the black lines are background. As you can see the red lines and black lines for baseline are not always overlap.

Here is the code.

please keep in mind that the output of the code varies since the data are randomly generated

library(ggplot2)

#predifine variables
value = c();Cond = c();measure = c();
value1 = c(); #as background

measures = c("measure1","measure2","measure3");
Conditions = c("baseline","cond1","cond2");
# prepare data.
n=1000

for (i in seq(1:length(measures))) {
  Valuetemp1=''; 

  for (j in seq(1:length(Conditions))) {

    Valuetemp=c(runif(n,0,1))
    if (j==1){Valuetemp1=Valuetemp} #valuetemp1 store the data for baseline

    value = c(value,Valuetemp);
    value1 = c(value1,Valuetemp1); # this is background
    Cond = c(Cond,rep(Conditions[j], length(Valuetemp)));
    measure = c(measure,rep(measures[i], length(Valuetemp)));
    }
  }

Cond=factor(Cond);

#generte data Frame for ploting
df = data.frame(
  index = 1:length(value), 
  measure,
  Cond,
  value
)
df1 = data.frame(
  index = 1:length(value), 
  measure,
  Cond,
  value1)

# ploting
p = ggplot()

p + 
  geom_violin(data=df1, mapping=aes(Cond, value1)) +
  geom_violin(data=df, mapping=aes(Cond, value),alpha=0.5, color = "red") + 
                facet_grid(measure ~ . , scales = "fixed", space = "fixed") +
                ggtitle("Distribution") +
                xlab("Conditions") +
                ylab("Value")

Here is the result figure I got.

Does anyone know why this happen and how can I fix it?

Thanks

Qingyang Li
